mapper.insert: insert into batch.batch_day_replay_entry ( session_id, tenant_id, job_code, source_instance_id, rerun_instance_id, status, failure_reason, started_at, finished_at, result_version_id, plan_snapshot, created_at, updated_at ) values ( #{sessionId}, #{tenantId}, #{jobCode}, #{sourceInstanceId}, #{rerunInstanceId}, #{status}, #{failureReason}, #{startedAt}, #{finishedAt}, #{resultVersionId}, #{planSnapshot,jdbcType=VARCHAR}::jsonb, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt} ) on conflict do nothing

insert into batch.batch_day_replay_entry ( session_id, tenant_id, job_code, source_instance_id, rerun_instance_id, status, failure_reason, started_at, finished_at, result_version_id, plan_snapshot, created_at, updated_at ) values
( #{r.sessionId}, #{r.tenantId}, #{r.jobCode}, #{r.sourceInstanceId}, #{r.rerunInstanceId}, #{r.status}, #{r.failureReason}, #{r.startedAt}, #{r.finishedAt}, #{r.resultVersionId}, #{r.planSnapshot,jdbcType=VARCHAR}::jsonb, #{r.createdAt}, #{r.updatedAt} )
on conflict do nothing
mapper.select: select e.* from batch.batch_day_replay_entry e join batch.batch_day_replay_session s on s.id=e.session_id and s.tenant_id=e.tenant_id join batch.job_instance ji on ji.tenant_id=e.tenant_id and ji.replay_session_id=e.session_id join batch.workflow_node_run n on n.job_instance_id=ji.id and n.node_type='JOB' join batch.workflow_run w on w.id=n.workflow_run_id and w.tenant_id=e.tenant_id join batch.trigger_request tr on tr.id=w.trigger_request_id and tr.tenant_id=e.tenant_id where e.tenant_id=#{tenantId} and e.session_id=#{sessionId} and e.job_code=#{jobCode} and ji.job_code=e.job_code and ji.id=#{jobInstanceId} and ji.biz_date=s.biz_date and w.biz_date=s.biz_date and tr.request_id=concat('replay-',e.session_id,'-',e.id) and ji.parent_instance_id is not distinct from e.source_instance_id and not exists (select 1 from batch.workflow_node_run newer where newer.workflow_run_id=n.workflow_run_id and newer.node_code=n.node_code and newer.run_seq > n.run_seq)
mapper.update: with candidates as ( select e.id,min(ji.id) as job_id,count(distinct ji.id) as matches from batch.batch_day_replay_entry e join batch.batch_day_replay_session s on s.id=e.session_id and s.tenant_id=e.tenant_id join batch.job_instance ji on ji.tenant_id=e.tenant_id and ji.replay_session_id=e.session_id and ji.job_code=e.job_code join batch.workflow_node_run n on n.job_instance_id=ji.id and n.node_type='JOB' join batch.workflow_run w on w.id=n.workflow_run_id and w.tenant_id=e.tenant_id join batch.trigger_request tr on tr.id=w.trigger_request_id and tr.tenant_id=e.tenant_id where e.tenant_id=#{tenantId} and e.session_id=#{sessionId} and e.status='RUNNING' and e.rerun_instance_id is null and ji.biz_date=s.biz_date and w.biz_date=s.biz_date and tr.request_id=concat('replay-',e.session_id,'-',e.id) and ji.parent_instance_id is not distinct from e.source_instance_id and not exists (select 1 from batch.workflow_node_run newer where newer.workflow_run_id=n.workflow_run_id and newer.node_code=n.node_code and newer.run_seq > n.run_seq) group by e.id ) update batch.batch_day_replay_entry e set rerun_instance_id=c.job_id,updated_at=#{now} from candidates c where e.tenant_id=#{tenantId} and e.session_id=#{sessionId} and e.id=c.id and c.matches=1 and e.rerun_instance_id is null and e.status='RUNNING'

update batch.batch_day_replay_entry e set status=#{failedStatus},finished_at=#{now},updated_at=#{now}, failure_reason=concat('WORKFLOW_LAUNCH_',tr.request_status,': ',tr.request_id) from batch.trigger_request tr where e.tenant_id=#{tenantId} and e.session_id=#{sessionId} and e.rerun_instance_id is null and e.status in ('PENDING','RUNNING') and tr.tenant_id=e.tenant_id and tr.request_id=concat('replay-',e.session_id,'-',e.id) and tr.request_status in #{status} and not exists (select 1 from batch.workflow_run w join batch.workflow_node_run n on n.workflow_run_id=w.id join batch.job_instance ji on ji.id=n.job_instance_id and ji.tenant_id=w.tenant_id where w.tenant_id=e.tenant_id and w.trigger_request_id=tr.id and ji.job_code=e.job_code)

update batch.batch_day_replay_entry set status = #{toStatus}, rerun_instance_id = coalesce(#{rerunInstanceId}, rerun_instance_id), result_version_id = coalesce(#{resultVersionId}, result_version_id), failure_reason = coalesce(#{failureReason}, failure_reason), started_at = coalesce(#{startedAt}, started_at), finished_at = coalesce(#{finishedAt}, finished_at), updated_at = #{now} where id = #{id}
mapper.select: select count(1) from batch.batch_day_replay_entry where session_id = #{sessionId} and status = #{status}
